description: Western Heart assistant tool suite — two-tier routing. Tier 2 (free) is tried first; Tier 1 (token-based) is used when quality demands it.
routing_policy: Try Tier 2 first. Escalate to Tier 1 when: (1) Tier 2 quality is insufficient for the use case, (2) the user explicitly asks for the best quality, (3) the output is user-facing and first impressions matter, (4) Tier 2 is rate-limited or unavailable. Never escalate for bulk/background work unless the user approves the token spend.

tier1.cost: Consumes assistant tokens per call. No user API keys needed — the assistant's own access covers it.
tier1.description: Uses the assistant's own token/API budget. Highest quality. Use when free options fall short or the user explicitly wants the best result.
tier1.name: Token-based

tier2.cost: Free. Rate limits may apply on shared services.
tier2.description: No tokens, no cost, no user API keys. Open-source tools, free APIs, local processing. Default choice for bulk work and when quality is sufficient.
tier2.name: Free

tools.description: Edit an image from a natural-language instruction (e.g. 'make the shell red')
tools.name: image-edit-generative

tier1.method: Assistant's media pipeline (media.generate_image with image+text input)
tier1.when: User wants the best possible edit quality; complex or subtle changes; character art that must stay on-model

tier2.quality: Good — true instruction editing, occasional misinterpretation on tricky prompts
tier2.when: Default for pipeline/crew use; bulk edits; quick iterations; no assistant in the loop

tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt
tools.name: image-generate

tier1.when: Character concept art; user-facing deliverables; quality matters

tier2.when: Bulk generation; drafts; pipeline use without assistant

tools.description: Basic image ops: resize, crop, rotate, recolor, text overlay, format conversion
tools.name: image-edit-basic

tier2.when: Always — no reason to spend tokens on basic ops

tier1.quality: High — production Meta AI voices, multiple languages
tier1.when: User-facing voice lines; character voice previews; Dorowani's voice drafts

tier2.method: Repo voice pipeline (tools/character-voice/, Chatterbox default) on remote GPU
tier2.quality: Highest for character voices — zero-shot cloning, per-fighter tuning
tier2.when: Production character voices; batch line generation; voice cloning (runs on Kaggle/remote, not local disk)

tools.description: Generate video from prompt or animate an image
tools.name: video-generate

tier1.when: User requests video; cutscene previews; motion tests
